column1: # advertised-features.tsv — the ONE list of features this product's releases
# document as present, and the build options that must hold for that claim to be
# true. tests/release-honesty-gate.sh reads this file and nothing else: the gate
# carries no feature list of its own, so there is no second copy to drift from
# the release notes.
# The defect this file exists to prevent: the published v0.1.0-alpha advertised
# "VST3 and CLAP hosting, effects only" while all seven jobs of its release run
# printed
#   -- VST3 hosting skipped: no SDK at '<runner>/build/vst3sdk'
#   -- CLAP hosting skipped: no headers at '<runner>/build/clap/include/clap'
# and shipped neither. Both options default to AUTO, and AUTO with the
# dependency absent is a skip with a STATUS line — a silent compile-out that no
# test and no log reader noticed.
# Columns (TAB separated):
#   1 feature   stable id, printed by the gate
#   2 option    the WANT_* option the binary reports in its "Build options:" dump
#   3 required  the value that must hold: ON, OFF, or an exact string
#   4 module    plugin module basename to find in the build tree ('-' for none)
#   5 claim     the sentence this row keeps true, quoted when the gate fails
# A feature documented as ABSENT is a row too (required OFF). If a build turns
# one on, the documents understate that build and the release is dishonest in the
# other direction, so the gate fails on it as well.
# Column legend (a real row, unlike this line, is tab separated and has no '#'):
#feature
vst3-hosting
